meta.L2_algorithm: 4-stage Gauss-Legendre (order 8) symplectic IRK + Chebyshev theta1 log-deriv wp + log-radial inward transform
meta.gramian_algorithm: Direct Hermitian H_L = (1/K) sum Y Y^H diagonalized via mp.eigh (dps=180 at y=30, 125 at y=20, 75 at y=10, 65 at y<=5)
meta.haar_algorithm: Independent Cayley transform U = (I - i H)(I + i H)^{-1} from integer PRNG Hermitian H
